title: Diorama Isométrico 3D de Personajes de Serie de TV Noir Francesa de Detectives
prompt: Stylized and incredibly detailed ultra-high-fidelity 3D isometric miniature models showcasing core characters from a French noir detective TV series set in Paris. Each character displays a different signature detective move or pose. Soft studio lighting creates stunning light and shadow effects. The highly detailed 3D character models are placed on cobblestone Parisian streets with vintage lampposts and café tables, against a pure white background. Miniature diorama style with cinematic lighting.
